name: Teen Action Academy and Teen Leadership Committee
what_you_do: Teen Action Academy is for grades 9 to 12. It plans service projects and teen events. Teen Leadership Committee is for grades 7 to 8. It builds leadership and teamwork.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12 (two separate groups).
deadline_text: Not posted on the volunteer page.
how_to_apply: No steps are posted. Email MadisonLeeRosen@CosumnesCSD.gov, call the District at 916-405-5600, or fill out the General Volunteer Interest Form on cosumnescsd.gov.
notes: Meeting times, location and deadlines are not posted on the page, so ask the District. Other volunteer roles on that page (adaptive recreation, youth coaching) are 18 and older.
